evidence: The film thicknesses and refractive indices at a wavelength of 580 nm were evaluated from reflectance spectra measured between 370 and 1100 nm by a Hitachi U-2000 spectrophotometer. All of the deposited aluminum phosphate films were X-ray amorphous. All of the titanium phosphate films deposited successfully at various temperatures in this study proved to be X-ray amorphous.
